faq.q: Do Waltham movers from Better Life Moving handle office moves?
faq.a: Yes. We move offices and retail spaces in Waltham, planned around the hours your business can close.

faq.q: What does a local move in Waltham cost?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Your quote gives the rate.

faq.q: Can I see reviews from Waltham customers?
faq.a: Yes. Our Thumbtack profile is listed under Waltham, and our Google reviews appear in the widget on this page.

faq.q: Can you move my Waltham house to another state?
faq.a: Yes. That's a long distance move, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own truck.

faq.q: Can packing be added to a Waltham move?
faq.a: Yes. Full or partial packing goes on the same quote as the move, priced together by the manager.

faqClosing: Want more detail? The FAQ page explains billing, deposits and moving day.

closing.body: Home or office, send the date and both addresses. We'll explain the billing before anything is booked.
